senses.gloss:
m. (-ञ्चः)
1 Reverse, opposition, reversion or inversion.
2 Extent, expanse.
3 Heap, abundance, quantity.
4 Delusion, deceit, trick or fraud.
5 Joke, jest.
6 Prolixity, copiousness, in style or composition.
7 Error, illusion.
8 The world.
E.
प्र before पचि to spread, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Expanded, diffused.
2 Erring, mistaken.
3 Tricked, deceived, beguiled.
4 Declared fully, explained, treated at length.
E.
प्रपञ्च prolixity, इतच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Death, dying.
2 Destruction.
3 Falling.
4 Alighting.
E.
प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dead.
2 Decayed.
3 Fallen.
4 Come down.
E.
प्र before पत to fall, क्त aff.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Languid, enervated, relaxed.
E.
प्र before पथ to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-थः)
A road.
E.
प्र before पथ to go, aff. घञ्.

n. (-दं)
The point of the foot, the tip of the toes.
E.
प्र projecting, and पद the foot.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Relating to the top of the foot, extending to it, fitting it, &c.
E.
प्रपद, and ख aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Taking refuge with.
2 Reaching, arriving at.
3 Seeking, adhering to.
4 Effecting, producing.
5 Promised, assented to.
6 Attained, obtained, possessed of.
7 Poor.
8 Distressed.
E.
प्र before पद to go, क्त aff.

m. (-र्णः)
A fallen leaf.
E.
प्र before पर्ण leaf.

n. (-नं)
Flight, running away.
E.
प्र before पलायन flying.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Routed, defeated.
E.
प्र before पलायित the same.

m. (-यी)
A fugitive, one who deserts his cause.
E.
प्र before पलायिन् who flies.

n. (-णं)
Purifying.
E.
प्र before पू to purify, ल्युट् aff. न optionally changed, whence also प्रपवन.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be purified or cleansed.
E.
प्र before पू to purify, अनीयर् aff.; also प्रपवनीय.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्)
Foreseeing.
E.
प्र, and पश्यत् seeing.

f. (-पा)
A place where water is distributed.
E.
प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Watery, abounding with water.
E.
प्र, and अप water.

m. (-णिः)
The palm of the hand.
E.
प्र prostrate, and पाणि the hand.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Drinkable.
E.
प्र before पा to drink, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 A cliff, a precipice.
2 A cascade, or water-fall.
3 A bank, a shore.
4 Facing an enemy.
E.
प्र before पत to descend, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A peacock.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Who or what drinks.
2 Who or what protects.
E.
प्र before पा to drink, &c. घिनुण् aff. and आय inserted.

n. (-नं)
A grove, a pleasure garden.
E.
प्रपा a place of refreshment, and वन a wood.

m. (-हः)
1 A paternal great grandfather.
2 A name of BRAHMĀ.
f. (-ही)
A paternal great grandmother.
E.
प्र preceding, पितामह a grandfather.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing or intending to descend, alight, fall, &c.
E.
प्र before पत to go, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-डः)
A sort of Cassia, (C. tora): see प्रपुन्नाड.

m. (-डः)
Cassia tora: see प्रपुन्नाड.

m. (-डः)
A tree, (Cassia tora.)
E.
प्र excellently, पुपस् manking, and णल to smell, aff. अण्, the स of पुमस् is rejected, and the ल of the radical changed optionally to ड; the antepenultimate is occasionally short, and one of the conjunct न is sometimes rejected; whence the word is variously written, प्रपुन्नाल, or प्रपुन्नड, or प्रपुनाड, &c.

f. (-न्ना)
A sort of grass, (Hedysarum alhaji.)

m. (-लः)
Cassia tora: see the last.

n. (-णं)
The drawing out of a bow string for the purpose of shooting.

f. (-का)
A prickly nightshade, (Solanum Jacquini.)

m. (-कः)
A small herbaceous plant, used in medicine, and as a perfume, commonly Punderya; in medicine it forms the basis of applications to ulcers, and bad eyes.
E.
प्र excellent, पुण्डरीक the same, and अण् pleonastic aff.

m. (-त्रः)
A great grandson.
f. (-त्री)
A great granddaughter.
E.
प्र preceding, पौच a son's son.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Fat, bulky.
E.
प्र before प्याय to be fat, क्त aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Procuring, causing to obtain.
2 Obtaining, who or what obtains.
E.
प्राप to obtain, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-णं)
Obtaining.
E.
प्र before आप to gain, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A trader, a dealer.
2 A retail dealer.
E.
प्र and आङ् before पण to deal, to transact business, किकन Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Brought, placed.
2 Procured.
E.
प्र before आप to gain, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Obtained, gained, received, procured.
2 Fixed, placed.
3 Proper, right.
E.
प्र before आप to gain, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Fated, destined, one whose fated time has come.
2 Opportune, in season.
E.
प्राप्त, and काल time.

mfn. (-त्वः-त्वा-त्वं)
Dead, deceased.
E.
प्राप्त obtained, पञ्चत्व death.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
1 Enlightened, instructed, intelligent.
2 Recovering, becoming conscious, (after fainting.)
E.
प्राप्त, and बुद्धि understanding.

m. (-रः)
A draft ox or beast of burthen.
E.
प्राप्त, and भार load.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Wise.
2 Handsome.
3 Of a good disposition.
m. (-वः)
A bullock.
E.
प्राप्त gained, भाव disposition.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Learned, wise.
2 Handsome, pleasing.
E.
प्राप्त gained or proper, रूप form.

mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-थं)
Successful, having gained an object.
E.
प्राप्त, and अर्थ object.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Offending, being in fault.
E.
प्राप्त, and अपराध offence.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Opportune, seasonable, taking or finding occasion.
E.
प्राप्त, and अवसर opportunity.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Gain, profit.
2 Acquiring, getting, obtaining.
3 Improvement, success.
4 Rise, ascent.
5 Collection, assemblage, quantity.
6 Happy denouement, successful termination of a plot.
7 Guessing, discovering from a hint.
8 One of the eight superhuman faculties, the power of obtaining every thing.
E.
प्र before आप to get or obtain, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Attainable, obtainable.
E.
प्र before आप to attain, aff. ण्यत्.
